name: legacy-tools-changed-tool-search
description: The legacy inline form: a deferred MCP tool pinned with its schema shows in line 0 as {name, description, deferred: true}, and a tools_changed{cause: tool_search} restates the complete set with the loaded spec (rule 17 point 2). Nothing writes this form any more, but it stays readable. Line 0 stays byte-equal.
